subject: Finalizing MAP & dataset handover schedule
messages:
From: Alice Chen <alice@helixretail.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: MAP + probe dataset handover

Hi Lauren,

Thanks for the product walkthrough yesterday — Helix is excited to run a short evaluation against our merchandising prompt pack. We put together a small sample of test cases and a prompt pack (attached) that mirrors production traffic patterns. Before we share the full archive we'd like to align on a mutual action plan and a couple of usage constraints so legal and procurement can sign off.

High level asks from our side:
- A one-page MAP that lists milestones, owners, and target dates
- Confirmation that prompt pack artifacts will be treated as "ephemeral" for evaluation (auto-delete after X days) unless agreed otherwise
- Test environment access pattern (will you run tests in Hosted vs Dedicated?)
- Any required attestations (SOC2 access logs, audit trail for dataset access)

Attached: helix_promptpack_v1.zip (sample prompts + testcases)

Can you share a draft MAP and the retention options you support? Procurement is waiting on the timeline to issue a PO. Ideal close: by end of month.

Thanks —
Alice
Director, ML Evaluation
Helix Retail
[Attachment: helix_promptpack_v1.zip (4.2 MB)]

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice@helixretail.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T11:50:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: MAP + probe dataset handover

Hi Alice —

Appreciate the clear asks and the sample pack. We've reviewed the artifact and can support the evaluation under a short MAP with staged deliverables. Draft summary and options below; I'll attach a one-page MAP PDF in this thread.

Proposed MAP (high level):
- Nov 10: MAP sign-off (scope, retention policy, PO trigger) — owner: Helix (Alice), Redwood (Lauren)
- Nov 15: Full dataset delivery to Redwoods staging bucket (encrypted, access logs enabled) — owner: Helix
- Nov 16–Nov 22: Evaluation run (Redwood hosted runtime; optional dedicated slot on request) — owner: Redwood (Dev)
- Nov 23: Issue findings & quality signal report + cost/throughput summary — owner: Redwood
- Nov 30: Final sync and close (go/no-go) — owner: Helix + Redwood

Retention options (pick one):
- Ephemeral (recommended for sensitive prompt packs): auto-delete 14 days after ingestion; logs retained per SOC2 for 90 days
- Short-term persistent: retain artifacts for 90 days, access audited, destroyed on request after close
- Controlled long-term: retained under NDA/PO terms (customer-managed keys optional)

Operational notes:
- By default we'll run in Hosted (fastest), but we can allocate a Dedicated slot for the evaluation window if you need workload isolation — there may be a short capacity lead time.
- We will enable object-level access logs and provide a signed audit export at the end of the evaluation run.

Attachments in this message: Helix_MAP_v2.pdf (draft we propose you review) and Redwood_MAP_Addendum (notes on retention & KMS).

If this looks good, sign the attached MAP and send PO; procurement can use the DocuSign link we provided. Dev/Monica — can you confirm the default ephemeral deletion pipeline and whether 14 days is enforceable from ingestion timestamp?

Lauren
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Helix_MAP_v2.pdf][Attachment: redwood_mpa_addendum.docx]

From: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-09T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: MAP + probe dataset handover

Lauren, Monica —

14-day ephemeral retention is doable and we have two enforcement mechanisms:
1) Ingestion-time TTL on the staging bucket objects (server-side lifecycle policy) — automatic delete + retention logs.
2) Application-level shred job tied to the evaluation job ID; we emit an audit event when shred completes.

If Helix requires KMS-controlled keys we can support customer-managed keys (CMK) for the staging bucket but there will be a short provisioning window (24–48 hours) and a small cost delta. For Hosted runs we will keep the KV cache ephemeral by default; if they opt for Dedicated, we will pin a dedicated instance but still enforce artifact TTL.

I'll prepare a short runbook for the ingestion step and the audit export (S3 path + expected JSON schema).

—Dev
Senior Infra Eng, Redwood Inference
